name: begin_event_mode

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_BeginEventMode does not access or change the Script value stack

notes: ScriptCommand_BeginEventMode sets event-state bit 0x2 in D_00375BC0 and calls func_00133538 to clear the paired object-manager mode bit. The JP corpus contains 413 calls, predominantly in event setup sequences alongside disable_party_damage, disable_all_object_control, and other scene-wide setup commands. Command 512 is the cleanup counterpart that waits for pending event audio and clears both low event-state bits.
